instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Inside a martial arts gym with grey padded walls, the man in the black t-shirt (R1) on the left and the shirtless man with a mullet (R2) on the right spar with their backs partially turned. The man in the black t-shirt (R1) delivers a low kick that connects with the thigh of the shirtless man (R2), who tenses to absorb the impact. Both wear white shin guards. In the background, blurred figures stand near large windows. Bright, natural light from the background mixes with overhead gym lighting on the grey floor.
